REAL session captured from a live retest after the round-1 fixes. User picked 'UI/UX Designer' at Flipkart with no experience modifier → defaulted to mid-level band (totalMin:14, totalMax:32 → initialOffer ≈ ₹20.3 LPA, which is correct math for mid). Despite that, the LLM produced 6 distinct failures across 6 turns — none of which the round-1 detector set caught because the phrasings differed. This fixture pins them all so the next 'fix' must keep them green:
  • Turn 2: number-echo bug (candidate said ₹24, AI echoed ₹20)
  • Turn 4: counter-offer never explicitly stated despite candidate making the ask
  • Turn 5: PHANTOM COUNTER — 'our current offer of ₹24 LPA' when AI never actually moved from ₹20 (this is new — the LLM teleported the offer to match the target)
  • Turn 6: PREMATURE CLOSE with the variant phrasing 'I'll work with HR to put together the final, formal offer letter' (the round-1 regex anchored on 'let me put together the final numbers' / 'HR will send' and missed 'I'll work with HR to put together'). Also REPEATED QUESTION — notice period asked again after being asked in turn 4.
  • The italic copper words 'align' / 'what' / 'situation' visible in screenshots were the rendering side (pickAccent in _accent-parser.ts ACCENT_PRIORITY set), not LLM markdown — fixed by gating pickAccent off in salary-negotiation mode.
